description: Na₅Co₂O₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.80 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.54 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.50 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.39 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.45 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.97 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.00 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Co atoms to form distorted ONa₄Co₂ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONa₅Co octahedra and edges with four ONa₄Co₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-67°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Co atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form distorted ONa₅Co octahedra that share corners with eight ONa₄Co₂ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-67°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form ONa₅Co octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONa₅Co octahedra and edges with three ONa₄Co₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-55°.
